source_snapshot.procedure: In BMC WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs, check Chassis information/detail and compare FRU data with `ipmitool fru print`.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES assumes one `/Chassis/FRU_PSU` object and extracts Manufacturer, ProductName, SerialNumber and live Status. It does not enumerate PSU slots, establish slot/feed/IPMI-FRU mapping, preserve complete Board/Product/MultiRecord power-supply fields, distinguish persistent identity/rating from time-sensitive state or perform the required IPMI parity.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION correctly requires every PSU, exact slot/IPMI mapping, complete static and separately timed live evidence with a no-power/no-write boundary, but retains Pending for finite Project topology and acceptance data.

old_problem: One plausible PSU resource can hide an absent, swapped or degraded second supply, and a current Status object cannot substitute for complete static FRU areas or electrical/redundancy tests. The earlier review found these gaps but left the PSU population, feed map, expected FRU values and state semantics as an unresolved engineering decision.
disposition_reason: Enumerate every expected PSU slot and discovered PowerSupply/Chassis resource plus all IPMI FRU devices, bind them through the approved slot/feed map, compare complete namespace-correct identity/rating data across IPMI, Redfish and actual WebUI, and assess separately timestamped presence/state/health/input/output under approved semantics. Topology, expected fields and policies are versioned Project configuration; no unplug, load, failover or power action is introduced.
decision_basis: XLSX row 975, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 976 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 976 / variant 6ace03d7519c889e.

The IPMI FRU specification defines separate Board/Product areas and MultiRecord power-supply information. Manufacturer/name/serial alone omits distinct namespaces, part/version/asset/custom fields and supported rating data.

DMTF PowerSupply and Chassis models distinguish persistent identity/location/rated capacity from live Status and metrics. All expected slots must be mapped; a guessed aggregate `FRU_PSU` resource is not completeness evidence.

This inventory case may validate read-only live state at the capture time but cannot prove feed redundancy, rated load delivery, unplug/failover behavior or power-cycle recovery; those remain separate source coverage.

ED-02, ED-03, ED-08, ED-13, ED-15, ED-17, ED-19, ED-21 and ED-30 require exact identity, OEM restraint, visual evidence, SPEC-backed N/A and independent coverage; ED-33 through ED-38 allow parameterized execution and prohibit log clear, FRU/power-policy writes, PSU manipulation, reset/power and retry.

test_case.test_name: Validate every PSU slot's complete static FRU and separately captured live power-supply state
test_case.purpose: Verify every Project-defined PSU slot/feed has the correct installed or intentionally absent supply, persistent identity and rating information agree across read-only IPMI FRU, discovered Redfish and actual BMC WebUI, and separately timestamped live presence/state/health/input/output fields satisfy the approved current-state policy without modifying power, PSU or FRU state.
required_package: Immutable SUT/BMC/chassis/power-subsystem/WebUI identity and complete PSU slot-to-feed/redundancy-domain topology
Approved PSU population/build matrix by slot with expected manufacturer/model/product/part/version/serial or stable token, rated capacity and supported FRU power records
Mapping among each physical slot, IPMI FRU device ID/description, Redfish PowerSupply/Chassis/Assembly resource and WebUI entry
Versioned Board, Product, MultiRecord/custom field and encoding/blank/unsupported rules plus field-specific Redfish semantic mapping
Approved live presence, Status.State/Health/Conditions, input/output/line-state, redundancy-domain and freshness semantics for the captured power context
Read-only IPMI decoder and DMTF-schema-aware client, actual rendered WebUI detail, trusted sessions, protected identifier tokens, preserved logs and evidence storage
test_case.test_command: READ ONLY. Verify immutable target and current system/power context. Discover the chassis PowerSubsystem/PowerSupplies or target-advertised legacy power/chassis resources and enumerate every page/member; independently enumerate `ipmitool fru print` devices with ID/description. Build one row for every expected PSU slot, including intentionally empty/unsupported slots, and bind its physical slot/feed/redundancy domain to the approved IPMI, Redfish and WebUI identities. For each installed supply compare exact Chassis/Board/Product fields plus Power Supply Information/DC output or required MultiRecord/custom fields, manufacturer/model/part/version/serial token, rated CapacityWatts and supported input/output ratings by explicit semantic map. In a separate time-stamped section record current presence, Status.State/Health/Conditions, input/output/line state and metrics only where exposed and compare to the approved current-context policy. Capture the actual rendered WebUI PSU/chassis table and every required detail. Preserve pre/post SEL/audit logs. Do not clear logs, edit FRU, unplug/reseat a PSU, change power policy/redundancy, apply load, actuate indicators, reset/reboot or power-cycle.
test_case.expected_result: Every expected PSU slot is represented exactly once with correct population, feed/domain mapping and no missing, extra, duplicate or swapped supply. Installed static identity/rating fields match the approved per-slot baseline across their exact IPMI namespaces, Redfish and actual WebUI; live state/health/input/output evidence is fresh and acceptable under the recorded context. Empty/unsupported slots follow approved representation. Static and live sections remain separate, protected identifiers correlate without disclosure, and power/FRU/system state is unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires every-slot accounting, authoritative physical/feed/interface mapping, complete required Board/Product/MultiRecord identity/rating parity, separately fresh live-state evaluation, actual rendered WebUI details and protected identifiers. One `FRU_PSU` URI, four fields, aggregate redundancy, name/serial only or static FRU used to infer live electrical behavior cannot pass. Missing/extra/swapped/duplicate PSU, wrong slot/feed/identity/rating, stale or unacceptable health/input/output, namespace substitution or UI/Redfish/IPMI/reference mismatch is FAIL. Missing topology, population, field mapping or live-state policy is NOT READY rather than Pending; unsupported/N/A requires specification proof.
safety_gate: Use certificate-verified read-only Redfish and read-only IPMI FRU operations with protected credentials; discover all resources/device IDs before selection.
Bind every PSU to the approved physical slot, feed and redundancy domain; resource order, one aggregate endpoint or similar serial/model text is insufficient.
Keep persistent Board/Product/MultiRecord/rating fields separate from time-stamped Status and metrics; neither establishes load delivery or failover capability.
Protect PSU serial and asset values with stable tokens in shared artifacts and retain raw evidence only in controlled storage.
Preserve logs; prohibit FRU edit, PSU unplug/reseat, power-policy/redundancy change, load/failover stimulus, LED actuation, reset/reboot and power transitions.
Stop on unknown slot/FRU ID, stale health, input loss or cross-interface disagreement; do not automatically retry through PSU or power action.
expected_evidence: Immutable target/schema/decoder identity and approved PSU slot/feed/redundancy topology, population and static/live policies
Complete redacted PowerSupply/Chassis/Assembly artifacts and read-only IPMI FRU output with member/device coverage, timestamps and hashes
Per-slot mapping joining physical/feed domain, IPMI device, Redfish resource and WebUI entry including empty/unsupported accounting
Static namespace-correct Board/Product/MultiRecord/rating parity matrix with protected identities and per-field verdicts
Separate time-stamped state/health/input/output matrix and actual rendered WebUI PSU/chassis table/detail visual comparison
Preserved pre/post logs, no-write/no-unplug/no-load/no-reset/no-power proof and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: No mutation is intended. On missing/swapped PSU, ambiguous slot/feed, parse/checksum concern, stale/unacceptable live state or mismatch, stop and preserve/redact complete IPMI, Redfish, WebUI and log evidence for the power owner. Do not clear logs, edit FRU, manipulate PSU/power policy/redundancy, add load, actuate LEDs, reset/reboot, power-cycle or automatically retry.

source_conflict.reason: The Master consistently requires PSU FRU WebUI/IPMI parity. DeepSeek's added Status is a compatible but separately interpreted live checkpoint, not a contradictory source purpose.

blocked.reason: Passive per-slot PSU FRU and live-status verification is standard and technically defined. Topology, population, expected fields and state semantics are bounded Project inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: PSU slot/feed/redundancy topology and population; IPMI ID↔Redfish↔WebUI mapping; expected Board/Product/MultiRecord/rating fields; live presence/health/input/output/freshness policy; trust and redaction.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; READ-ONLY PSU FRU/STATUS REVIEW ONLY; NO REDFISH, IPMI, WEBUI, LOG CLEAR, FRU WRITE, PSU/POWER/LOAD/LED, RESET OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
